_meta: editorconfig-checker makes .editorconfig a gate instead of a suggestion.
Language formatters own exact indent width; this catches EOL, indentation kind, final newline, trailing whitespace, and charset across the long tail.

_IndentSize_reason: Continuation alignment is valid in Python and shell but is not always a multiple of the declared indent. Ruff, gofmt, rustfmt, zig fmt, and shfmt own exact width.
_MaxLineLength_reason: The repository declares no universal line cap; formatters understand URLs, literals, and aligned benchmark data better than one integer.
